transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess… I came in because I don’t really care about things the way I used to. Dance class, hiking, cooking, game night… it all just feels like stuff I’m supposed to do, and I keep putting it off.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say depressed most of the day. It’s more like I’m just kind of flat, I guess.
Do you often feel down or depressed for most of the day, even when there’s no obvious reason for it?
Not really… I mean, I have off days, but I wouldn’t say I’m down most of the day for no reason. Mostly I just feel kind of… numb, I guess.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, even activities you once looked forward to?
Yeah… I guess that’s the main thing. Stuff I used to look forward to—dance, hiking, cooking, game night—it just feels like another chore now, so I don’t really do it.
Can you tell me more about how you feel when you do these activities now compared to before?

Before, those things made me feel like… me, I guess. Dance class or hiking used to feel good, like I actually wanted to be there. Now I just think about doing them and it feels like another thing I have to force myself through. So I put it off, even game night or cooking. I just don’t really care like I used to.
Do you feel depressed or down for most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t think so… not most of the day, nearly every day. It’s more like I feel kind of flat or shut off, if that makes sense.
Would you say that most days, for most of the day, you feel down or depressed, even if it’s not all the time?
Not really… I wouldn’t say down or depressed most of the day. It’s more just… muted, I guess. Like I’m not really feeling much.
Would you say that you feel down or depressed for a good part of most days, even if it's not all day?
I don’t think I’d call it depressed, no. It’s more like I’m just… not really there emotionally. Hard to say.
Do you feel down or depressed for a significant part of most days, even if it’s not all day?
I’m not sure… I don’t think I’d say depressed for a significant part of most days. It’s more just kind of hard to label.
Would you say that on most days, you feel down or depressed for at least a few hours, even if it's not the whole day?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed it like that. I wouldn’t say I feel down for hours most days, exactly.
Would you say that on most days, you feel down or depressed for at least a few hours, even if it's not the whole day?
I guess… no, I don’t think it’s most days for hours. I just haven’t really tracked it that way.
Would you say that on most days, you feel down or depressed for at least a few hours, even if it's not the whole day?
I mean… I don’t think so. Not most days, not for a few hours. I just don’t really notice it that way.
Would you say that on most days, you feel down or depressed for at least a few hours, even if it's not the whole day?
I… I don’t think so. I haven’t really been keeping track, but I wouldn’t say it’s most days like that.
Would you say that on most days, you feel down or depressed for at least a few hours, even if it's not the whole day?
I don’t think I can really say yes to that. I mean, I have bad moods, but… most days for hours? I’m not sure.
